t: A free visual audio programming tool based on Pure Data.
steps: Download the installer for your operating system from the plugdata site.
Ask IT to approve the install on Windows, Mac, or Linux computers.
Check that each computer has audio output and headphones.
Open the built in help for one object.
Build a simple tone with a few connected blocks.
Save a patch in a class folder.
Open a standard Pure Data patch to test compatibility.
